key: KXDEDUCT|What will the standard deduction be in the Republican reconciliation bill?|If the first budget reconciliation bill to become law before Jan 1, 2027 sets the standard deduction for married couples filing jointly to be at least $25 thousand, then the market resolves to Yes.
reasoning: The first budget reconciliation bill to become law before January 1, 2027 was P.L. 119-21 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act), signed into law on July 4, 2025. This bill sets the standard deduction for married couples filing jointly at $31,500 for tax year 2025. Since $31,500 is at least $25,000, the resolution criteria are satisfied, and the market resolves to YES.
